# Patchwork's Plastering Company: full business facts

Canonical page: https://diyregistry.com/s/patchworks-plastering/
Facts checked: 2026-10-24. This is a RegisterMySite demo, not yet published by the business.

## Identity
- Name: Patchwork's Plastering Company (Yelp and MapQuest list it as "Patchwork's Plastering & Patching Specialists")
- Owner-operator: Aston C. Hill (sole ownership)
- Background: Aston says he has 40+ years of plastering experience. He's a second-generation plasterer trained by his father, also a plastering contractor, in England. He founded Patchwork's in 1997.
- Address: 12331 Elmwood St, Garden Grove, CA 92840
- Phone: (714) 530-5119
- Email: aston.patchworks@yahoo.com
- Languages: English

## License
- California CSLB C-35 Lathing and Plastering #737480: current and active, issued 1997-06-25, expires 2027-06-30. Bonded for $25,000. Workers' comp exempt (no employees). Verify: https://www.cslb.ca.gov/OnlineServices/CheckLicenseII/LicenseDetail.aspx?LicNum=737480
- Orange County fictitious business name filed 2022-10-21

## Hours
- Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
- Saturday 9:00 AM–4:00 PM
- Sunday closed

## Services
- Exterior stucco repair and patching, including after electrical panel upgrades, plumbing access, and dog-door or vent removal
- Interior lath and plaster repair in vintage homes (button board, wood lath)
- Refreshing or replacing plaster ceilings and walls
- Matching old-world textures, such as 75-year-old swirl stucco
- Plastering over hard acoustic texture ceilings
- Drywall repair
- Water-damage stucco repair; stucco retaining and garden walls
- Foundation vent screen repair and replacement
- Specializes in small to medium jobs

## How to get a bid
- Email aston.patchworks@yahoo.com with as much detail as possible, photos or video of the work, and the city the job is in. Or call (714) 530-5119.
- Bids from photos are possible. Aston coordinates by text and email.
- No published prices. Reviewers describe the pricing as "fair" and "competitively priced."

## Service area
- Orange County. Reviews mention Garden Grove, Santa Ana (Floral Park), Orange and Huntington Beach.

## On-page tool
- Stucco & Plaster Patch Planner: you pick the surface, cause, size, texture and whether paint follows. It shows a job tier (small, medium or larger), the typical repair steps, any inspection-hold note, drying guidance before paint, and the photo checklist. It then pre-fills an email to Aston. It's a rough guide with no prices.
